content.value: A string is stretched and fastened to two points l apart. The string is displaced, to give motion, in the form $\imath \imath = a \sin \left( \frac { \pi x } { l } \right)$ from which it is released at time t=0. Show that the displacement of any point at a distance x from one end at time t is given by $u \left( x , t \right) = a s \mathrm { i n } { \left( \frac { \pi x } { l } \right) } \mathrm { c o s } { \left( \frac { \pi c t } { l } \right) } .$
(Answer ANY THREE questions from this section in Script B)

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2018
